methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
The energy consumption per part consists of two parts: the
particular solution, which is dynamic and is the energy per
part consumed due to random downtime events and the
homogeneous solution, which is static and is the energy
consumption due to the interactions of machines without any
disruption events.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
Extensive numerical simulations are performed to validate
the Energy Proﬁt Bottleneck.

level_3b.evidence_quote:
This paper investigates the dynamic energy structure of a
serial production line to incorporate the warmup time and
better understand the energy consumption per part EPP.

stage1.notes: Simulated serial production line of parts; the continuous-flow model is a mathematical abstraction, not an application in a closed-list continuous-process sector.
